warrant: The observable follows collisionless Landau damping of a density perturbation: alpha (line 71) sets the perturbation and the initial Ex, and the electron moments, L2 and field energy record phase mixing and the field decay through vlasov/zero/ and vlasov/apps/. A wrong phase-space flux, moment reduction or Poisson field changes these histories at order one. Calibration on the x86 worker (2026-09-05): the two-ULP variant moved the histories by at most 8.9e-15 and the strict-IEEE altbuild (same source, gcc -O2, no -ffast-math, -ffp-contract=off, no -march=native) by 2.1e-14; the bound atol=rtol=1e-11, confirmed at review on 2026-09-04, is about 470 times the larger of the two.
